title: asperula cynanchica subsp. capillacea
intro: Asperula cynanchica subsp. capillacea, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which provide therapeutic actions such as wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Asperula cynanchica subsp. capillacea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
